method: Exact six-digit UNITID set subtraction of pinned 2024-25 first-major completions index from pinned Scorecard national institutions. Eight-digit keys are excluded and held separately. Missing historical evidence is not a causal diagnosis or proof of no current programs.
interpretation_limits: No historical row does not mean no program exists, no awards were granted, or the institution is closed.
Scorecard control and degree codes describe pinned reference, not current catalog or accreditation.
Eight-digit prefix equality is not a verified campus or institution relationship.
Do not infer admissions testing policies from missing SAT/ACT scores.
No CIP-SOC crosswalk or licensing inference is authorized.
